### [Finding restricted parties in a messy vendor list](projects/denied-party-screening/index.qmd)

::: {.finding}
Exact-match screening missed a majority of true hits in testing. Fuzzy matching
caught them, but at a false-positive rate that would bury a small compliance
team — so the useful output is a ranked review queue, not a pass/fail flag. <span class="status">In progress</span>
:::

<p class="sourceline">Trade.gov Consolidated Screening List API · Python, rapidfuzz, SQLite</p>

## About this site

Every project here uses public government data or data I generated myself. None
of it comes from an employer. Each write-up follows the same structure: the
question, the data and its limits, the method, what I found, and what I would do
with more time.

Résumé and background are on the [about page](about.qmd).
